metaTitle: Boots vs Hiking Shoes vs Trail Runners
description: Compare hiking boots, hiking shoes and trail runners on support, weight, protection, drying time, durability and cost to pick the right footwear.
directAnswer: Boots give the most support and protection for heavy packs and rough or cold terrain. Hiking shoes sit in the middle, and trail runners are lightest and dry fastest, so choose by pack weight, terrain and weather.
